name: Nadi International Airport

permits.v: an operator not based in Fiji needs a Foreign Air Operator Certificate of Competency from CAAF for air transport services to, from or within Fiji, except for no more than two take-offs or two landings in Fiji in any 28 consecutive days, or medical emergencies
permits.quote: no person not domiciled in Fiji shall conduct an air transport service to, from or within Fiji ... Foreign Air Operator Certificate of Competency granted by CAAF

notes: The Fiji AIP is not published online; CAAF AIC 03/22 (19 May 2022) says copies are obtained from the Aeronautical Information Service (AISO@fijiairports.com.fj). The airportsfiji.com AIS page gave no AIP link and airportsfiji.com/aboutus.php failed to open. Fiji Airports' Nadi page and the Civil Aviation Master Plan 2026-2031 (Ministry of Tourism and Civil Aviation) give no runway dimensions or curfew. Only the 24/7 operating statement on Fiji Airports' FAQ page is recorded; it is an operator page, not the AIP. Operator: Airports Fiji Limited (airportsfiji.com, 'manages and operates'). 1 Nov 2026: added a permits rule from the CAAF 'Foreign Air Operator Certification Requirements' page (modified 24 Mar 2025); the page gives no notice period and does not say how charters are classed. CAAF AIC 04/11 (28 Jul 2011) covers only Fiji-based operators of foreign aircraft. No official runway, customs or curfew source found online; the Fiji AIP still has to be ordered from the AIS. | 3 Nov 2026: no runway, customs, curfew or slot rule added. Fiji Airports' 2020 works plan gives the codes (NFFN, NAN) and runways 02/20 and 09/27 but no lengths. Fiji's Customs Act (rev. 1 Aug 2023) s.11A requires notice to customs 'not less than 9 hours or less than the actual flight time' before arrival, wording to confirm with an agent; the 2013 Customs Regulations set general working hours (outdoor Mon-Thu 0800-1700, Fri 0800-1600), which are not recorded because they do not say that is the attendance at Nadi. The Fiji AIP still has to be ordered from the AIS; https://www.airportsfiji.com/aboutus.php failed again and https://www.airportsfiji.com/nadi_aiport.php has no such data. 5 Nov 2026: nothing new. No Nadi runway length, curfew, customs hours or slots in Fiji Airports' Annual Report 2022 (first 100,000 of 116,836 characters read), Our History, Master Plan and Information Desk pages, or the AFL newsletters of Nov/Dec 2010 and Sep/Oct 2012. The Fiji AIP still has to be ordered from the AIS. | 7 Nov 2026: nothing new. CAAF AIC 10/26 (Runway Distance Remaining Signs, 11 Jun 2026) and AIC 04/25 (pavement strength, 23 Mar 2025) give no Nadi runway data; AIC 10/26 says declared distances are in the AIP. The Fiji AIP still has to be ordered from the AIS (AISO@fijiairports.com.fj).
